analysis_patterns.name: RankUp representation diagnosis, original masked tensor probes
analysis_patterns.when_to_try: Named layer activations, valid-token masks, dataset/split/checkpoint identity and declared centering; repeated observed residuals or branch similarity, not guesses from architecture names.
analysis_patterns.required_evidence: Named layer activations, valid-token masks, dataset/split/checkpoint identity and declared centering; repeated observed residuals or branch similarity, not guesses from architecture names.
analysis_patterns.controlled_comparison: First collect diagnostics without changing predictions. Then compare one grouping, projection, sharing or interaction change against the same backbone using task quality and resource guardrails; do not maximize rank alone.
analysis_patterns.reject_if: Reject a proposed improvement if its controlled task metric does not support it, input/time/gradient provenance is invalid, or guardrails fail. An observation-only probe is not a performance improvement.
analysis_patterns.operation: Measure per-sample entropy effective rank, stable rank, token-axis output variance and optional paired-branch cosine similarity on supplied intermediate layers.

analysis_patterns.name: TayFCS-inspired first-order saliency and protected screening, original implementation
analysis_patterns.when_to_try: Training-split activations and aligned gradients from a declared objective, group/cross-to-source-field mapping, valid counts and protected interaction groups. Use repeated estimates before screening.
analysis_patterns.required_evidence: Training-split activations and aligned gradients from a declared objective, group/cross-to-source-field mapping, valid counts and protected interaction groups. Use repeated estimates before screening.
analysis_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep all source fields of protected interactions. Compare full-input and screened candidates after matched retraining; ablate nominated groups and report slices, uncertainty and cost. Correlation alone never drops a field.
analysis_patterns.reject_if: Reject a proposed improvement if its controlled task metric does not support it, input/time/gradient provenance is invalid, or guardrails fail. An observation-only probe is not a performance improvement.
analysis_patterns.operation: Measure mean absolute activation-times-gradient scores and pairwise-common-valid cosine redundancy for supplied field or explicit-cross tensors; select deterministically under a budget while retaining protected indices and interaction groups.

analysis_patterns.name: COLD-inspired protected physical-subset retraining
analysis_patterns.operation: Propose deterministic protected feature subsets from training-only saliency, invoke the host physical rebuild/retrain/evaluate callback for baseline and candidates, validate provenance/context, and report measured quality-latency feasibility and selection.
analysis_patterns.when_to_try: Supported feature-group screening and actual service measurements suggest a smaller retrained version of the current backbone may satisfy the declared quality and latency constraints.
analysis_patterns.required_evidence: Training-only saliency with field/cross lineage; protected interaction groups; a physical subset/retraining callback; immutable task/dataset/split/training/seed context; and measured hardware, batch/candidate count, concurrency, latency statistic and feature-lookup scope.
analysis_patterns.controlled_comparison: Retrain full-input and protected subsets with the same budget and evaluate validation quality and latency under exactly one serving profile. Keep the final holdout sealed; compare group ablations and critical slices before accepting a candidate.
analysis_patterns.reject_if: A callback lacks exact retained-index/context provenance, real retraining or physical-pruning attestations; protected groups disappear; metrics are invalid; or no candidate meets both constraints. Input zeroing and gate scores alone establish no speedup or feature value.
